modules.title: 长任务进入下一轮前，应该保留哪些资料
怎样保留要求，又不重复发送全部记录

items.title: 保留当前必须遵守的内容与规则载体
items.text: 当前目标、不能修改的范围和已确认决定要继续带入下一轮；还可以通过规则文件（如 AGENTS.md、.cursorrules）将规范沉淀在项目里，让任何新开的对话都能读取。

items.title: 用摘要代替重复记录
items.text: 任务推进后保留新的决定和未解决问题；重复对话与旧日志只保留仍然有效的结论。

items.title: 需要细节时再读取原文件
items.text: 大段原文不必每轮重复发送，但要保留文件位置和来源，定位问题时再读取相关部分。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 提示词工程主要关心指令怎样写；上下文工程还关心提示词之外的历史、工具、资料和中间结果在每一轮如何取舍。上下文窗口只是容量边界，窗口变大也不会自动挑出最相关的信息。

lessonPractice.title: 一个长任务里已经有需求、确认过的架构决定、几十页旧日志和大量重复工具输出。Agent 开始忽略最新限制，下一轮该怎样整理？

options.label: 保留目标、限制、架构决定和未解决问题；压缩旧日志，只在定位需要时按路径取回原文
options.feedback: 对。当前目标和限制要持续可见；重复记录可以改成摘要，需要细节时再按文件位置读取原文。

options.label: 把全部历史和工具原始输出再次放入上下文，避免遗漏任何一个字
options.feedback: 信息越全不等于重点越清楚；重复输出会占空间并掩盖当前限制。

options.label: 只把最后一句提示词改得更强硬，历史和工具结果保持原样
options.feedback: 问题不只在措辞。旧信息如何筛选、压缩和取回也是上下文工程的一部分。

en.title: A long task contains requirements, approved architecture decisions, dozens of pages of old logs, and repeated tool output. The agent starts missing the newest constraint. How should the next turn be prepared?

options.label: Keep the goal, constraints, architecture decisions, and open issues; compress old logs and retrieve originals by path only when needed
options.feedback: Correct. Critical decisions stay visible, low-signal material is compressed, and locators preserve access to details on demand.

options.label: Insert the entire history and every raw tool result again so no word can be omitted
options.feedback: More material does not mean clearer priorities. Repeated output consumes context and can bury the current constraint.

options.label: Make only the final instruction more forceful and leave all history and tool results unchanged
options.feedback: Wording is only one part. Selecting, compressing, and retrieving the rest of the context also matters.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这个任务已经很长了，你开始漏掉刚确认的限制。继续前请整理下一轮需要的资料：保留当前目标、不能修改的范围、已确认决定、相关文件和未解决问题；重复日志改成摘要，并留下原文件位置。先把整理结果给我确认，再继续。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: This task is long, and you have started missing a newly confirmed constraint. Before continuing, prepare a working context with the current goal, protected scope, approved decisions, relevant files, and open issues. List repeated logs and obsolete attempts as material to exclude, while keeping paths for on-demand retrieval. Show me the result for confirmation before proceeding.

learning.assumes: You know a model can receive prompts, chat history, files, and tool results.
learning.outcome: You can keep the current goal and constraints visible, replace repeated records with a summary, and preserve paths to the originals.

modules.title: What should a long task keep for its next turn?
How to preserve requirements without resending every record

items.title: Keep current requirements and rule carriers visible
items.text: Carry the goal, protected scope, and confirmed decisions into the next turn; project rules files (like AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) preserve conventions across separate chats.

items.title: Replace repetition with a summary
items.text: Keep new decisions and open questions, but reduce repeated chat and old logs to conclusions that still matter.

items.title: Read the original only when needed
items.text: Large originals do not need to be resent every turn, but their paths and sources must remain available.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Prompt engineering focuses on writing instructions. Context engineering also manages history, tools, sources, and intermediate results. A larger context window does not choose relevance for you.
